name: sample-content
title: Sample content
description: Invented placeholder data for the page templates: the sample product Lumen, its signed-in account, top bar and footer, image and video models, generations, projects, clips, assets, signed-in devices, credit usage, sidebar sections and canvas layers. Every template falls back to it when you leave its content props out, so it renders with no props at all, like a component with placeholder text. Replace all of it with real data before shipping.
